articles.title: Li Auto Deliveries Fall. The Stock Is Up.
articles.mainIdea: Li Auto Deliveries Fall. The Stock Is Up.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Li Auto Deliveries Fall. The Stock Is Up.. January started with a bang for Li Auto and Chinese EV peers. For starters, Li Auto delivered 44,246 cars in December, down 24% year over year, but about 4,000 more than investors expected. Li expected to deliver about 105,000 cars in the fourth quarter. Related tickers mentioned: NIO, XPEV, ^DJI, ^GSPC.
